requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Requirement is unambiguous and atomic. Structured as a single functional requirement defining the routing switch's capability to differentiate traffic types.

source_fragments: Routing switches ability to filter network traffic between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic.

fields.object: between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic

structured_requirements.final_statement: Routing switches shall filter network traffic between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic.
structuring_notes: Requirement is clear and atomic. No decomposition needed. 'Ability to filter' interpreted as the functional capability to perform the action.
